skill.name: app-store-screenshots
skill.description: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots with platform sizes, gallery order, captions, device mockups, and preview video planning.

skill.author: halt-catch-fire

security_audit.summary: Several static detections are real low-to-medium risks because the skill asks users to install and run the third-party belt CLI. The remaining detections are Markdown fences, diagrams, or metadata false positives; no prompt injection or covert exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution and related skill installs
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user review before running belt or npx skills add commands, and pin trusted install sources where possible.
Add a clear privacy note that prompts, screenshots, and generated assets may be sent to inference.sh or model providers.

content.value_statement: App teams need store images that meet strict platform rules. This skill guides screenshot order, captions, mockups, and preview videos.
actual_capabilities: Lists Apple App Store screenshot sizes for iPhone and iPad targets.
Lists Google Play screenshot limits, formats, aspect ratios, and feature graphic size.
Recommends screenshot gallery order, with focus on the first three images.
Explains common screenshot styles, including device frames, full-bleed UI, lifestyle context, and callouts.
Provides caption writing rules and examples for benefit-focused store copy.
Includes belt CLI examples for mockups, stitched comparisons, and preview video scenes.
limitations: It does not upload screenshots to Apple App Store Connect or Google Play Console.
It depends on the belt CLI and external inference services for generation examples.
Store requirements can change, so teams should verify current Apple and Google rules.
Generated images still need brand, legal, and product accuracy review.

use_cases.title: Launch Screenshot Set
use_cases.description: Plan the first store gallery for a new mobile app, including sizes, ordering, and caption themes.

use_cases.title: Conversion Refresh
use_cases.description: Improve weak store screenshots by moving the strongest value message into the first three positions.

use_cases.title: Localized Store Assets
use_cases.description: Prepare caption and screenshot priorities for major markets while keeping a consistent visual structure.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Screenshot Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan eight store screenshots for my app. My app helps [audience] do [main job].

prompt_templates.title: Write Benefit Captions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create benefit-focused captions for the first three screenshots. Keep each caption under two lines and avoid feature-only wording.

prompt_templates.title: Design Mockup Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Create mockup directions for iOS and Google Play screenshots. Include composition, device framing, background, and caption placement.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Localization Test Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan localized screenshot sets and Google Play experiments for [markets]. Include order, caption variants, and success metrics.

output_examples.input: A budgeting app needs its first three iOS screenshots.
output: Screenshot 1: See every bill before payday.
Screenshot 2: Spot spending changes in seconds.
Screenshot 3: Plan savings with clear weekly goals.

output_examples.input: A productivity app needs a Google Play listing plan.
output: Use portrait screenshots for task creation, calendar review, and team sharing.
Create a 1024 by 500 feature graphic with the main workflow visible.
Test one gallery with device frames and one full-bleed gallery.

output_examples.input: A recipe app needs a preview video outline.
output: Open with a finished dish and the app screen that found it.
Show ingredient search, step-by-step cooking, and saved favorites.
End with the app icon and a short download prompt.

best_practices: Put the clearest user benefit in the first screenshot.
Use exact platform dimensions before final export.
Keep captions short, readable, and focused on outcomes.
anti_patterns: Do not lead with settings, onboarding, or account creation screens.
Do not use long captions that become unreadable in store previews.
Do not make every screenshot use the same layout and message.

faq.question: Does this skill create final screenshots automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and belt CLI examples. Final assets still need review, export checks, and store upload.

faq.question: Can it support both Apple and Google stores?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes separate dimensions, formats, limits, and preview video guidance for each store.

faq.question: Does it help with app store optimization?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on gallery order, first-three screenshot impact, benefit captions, and A/B testing ideas.

faq.question: Can it help with localization?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests priority markets and different localization levels for screenshots and captions.

faq.question: What tools does it depend on?
faq.answer: The generation examples depend on the belt CLI and inference.sh model apps.

faq.question: Should I verify current store requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. Apple and Google requirements can change, so verify final dimensions and policies before submission.
